Rooftop lifestyle facilities including infinity pool, gym, wellness and activity spaces.

Only 326 units, offering better privacy and exclusivity.

facts.topReasons:
1. Best Transport Hub in ASEAN
Easy access to MRT, LRT, KTM, ERL, and Monorail, linking 10 train lines to 180 stations. Over 200,000 people pass through daily—great for future tenants and buyers.
2. Big City Vibes in 72 Acres
KL Sentral is a complete city with 21 office towers, 5 hotels, 4 residential areas (including Sentral Suites), and a shopping mall all in one place.
3. Second Biggest CBD After KLCC
KL Sentral is home to big companies like Google, Facebook, Allianz, Shell, and more, attracting professionals from around the world.
4. High Rental Demand
With many expats and high-income earners working nearby, monthly rentals range from RM3,000–5,000, giving steady ~5%+ returns.
5. Not Many Small Units Around
Small-sized homes (600–1,000 sq. ft.) are rare in KL Sentral. Older projects like Suasana Sentral Loft don’t offer the same views or facilities as Sentral Suites.
6. Last Residential Project in KL Sentral
This is the last residential plot in the 72-acre KL Sentral township. After this, only two commercial land plots are left.
7. Near Wealthy Neighborhoods
Bangsar, Seputeh, Damansara Heights, Mont Kiara, and PJ are all close by, adding more prestige to the area.
8. Easy to Go Anywhere
Whether by car or train, KL Sentral’s central location makes traveling super convenient.

facts.topReasons:
1. 3-min walk to top international school – Just 280m down the same street as ISKL (one of Malaysia’s 3 most expensive schools). No more long school runs.
2. Live among the wealthy & well-known – Uthant is a green, prestigious neighborhood filled with affluent families. Your neighbors? Successful & high-profile.
3. No skyscrapers, just privacy – Building height limited to 10 floors because 53 embassies nearby demand discretion. That means open skies & quiet streets.
4. Top-notch security – With embassy officials & VIPs living around, safety is already a priority. You get that protection too.
5. Low-density living, city-center close – Just 2km from KL city centre to Twin Towers, but without the crowds. Best of both worlds.
6. Spacious, no tiny units – Sizes range from 2,500 to 6,000+ sq ft. Everyone here values space. No small apartments.
7. Only 40 homes in this 1 acre – That’s ultra low density. More land, less people. True breathing room.
8. Better value than KLCC – At RM1,400 psf vs KLCC’s RM1,800 psf, you get luxury & space for less. Smart buy.
9. Last few units – FREE newly fully furnished – Developer clearing stock. Brand new furniture & appliances included. Just bring your suitcase & move in.
10. Built by a top developer – BSG is a top 3 developer in Penang, and the same team behind the successful 10 Stonor KLCC, Reizz Residence Ampang. You're buying from a name with proven quality.

1. Nature's Neighbour: Live adjacent to an 8-acre central park with a stunning lake view, all while being 330 meters above sea level.
2. Lush 3-Storey Living: Discover spacious and serene semi-detached homes, nestled in nature's lap. Perfect for families seeking both luxury and tranquility.
3. Unmatched Access: Connect to major highways such as DASH, LDP and Penchala Link effortlessly, making travel a breeze.
4. Matured Amenities: Enjoy the convenience of a developed township with all amenities close by.
5. 24/7 Security: Your peace of mind ensured with round-the-clock patrolling in a fenced and secure community.
6. Smart Living Ready: Step into the future with homes prepped for smart home infrastructure.
7. EV Charging Point: Power up your electric vehicle right at home with our dedicated EV charging stations.
8. Eco-Friendly Innovation: Embrace sustainability with our integrated rainwater harvesting system.
9. Universal Design: Experience comfort at any age with our elderly-friendly, universally accessible homes.
10. Secluded Yet Central: Revel in privacy and exclusivity, embraced by verdant greenery in a prime location.
